New York Herald, 5 June 1866, p. 8, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Steamship City of London (Br), Mirehouse, Liverpool May
23, at 3:45 PM, via Queenstown 24th, at 4:47 PM, with mdse
and 796 passengers, to John G Dale. May 24, off Saltees
lightship, saw steamship Bosphorus, bound E; same day, at
11 AM, off Ballycatton, steamship The Queen; at 5:20 PM,
off Kinsale, steamship Louisiana, bound E; at 9 PM, steam-
ship Etna, bound E; 25th, 96 miles west of Fastnet, steam-
ship China, bound E; 30th, lat 43 52, lon 48 34, a steamer,
supposed City of New York, bound E.
